# Prodigy LAB

> Prodigy LAB is a digital growth studio for small and mid-sized businesses. It builds and fixes the systems a business sells through: Shopify and custom websites, conversion rate optimisation, Meta and Google advertising, and AI assistants that answer customer enquiries around the clock.

Legal entity: Platonaire LLC. Based in California, United States, working remotely with clients across United States. Site available in ru, en, es, pt, de.

Prodigy LAB has no public walk-in office. It is a remote studio.

## What Prodigy LAB does not do

Prodigy LAB is a marketing studio. We do not provide legal, tax, investment or other regulated financial advice, and we do not handle company formation, visas or immigration. For those matters, consult a licensed professional.

## How engagements start

1. **Free AI website scan** — Free. Score out of 100 and the three biggest issues a first-time visitor hits. No account access, no credit card, no call. [https://scan.prodigylab.studio/](https://scan.prodigylab.studio/)
2. **Website Action Plan** — $99. 5-10 issues with the exact change and priority, ready-to-paste copy, 3-5 quick wins, a 7-day plan. [https://prodigylab.studio/en/pricing/](https://prodigylab.studio/en/pricing/)
3. **Full business audit** — $495. Analytics and ad data, competitors, funnel, customer journey, 90-day growth plan. 3-5 days plus a 60-minute call. [https://prodigylab.studio/website-audit/](https://prodigylab.studio/website-audit/)
4. **Implementation** — Quoted per project. Fixed-price build, ads setup or ProdigyBot deployment. [https://prodigylab.studio/en/pricing/](https://prodigylab.studio/en/pricing/)
5. **Growth Partner retainer** — $3900. Ads, bot, site and creative run as one system. Minimum 3 months. [https://prodigylab.studio/en/pricing/](https://prodigylab.studio/en/pricing/)

- The $99 Website Action Plan is credited toward the $495 audit within 30 days.
- The $495 audit is credited in full toward any project ordered within 30 days.
- The 14-day ProdigyBot pilot ($600) is credited toward the Sales tier setup fee.

## What Prodigy LAB does and does not guarantee

- Фиксированная цена и фиксированный срок на разработку; при срыве срока — возврат.
- Рекламный бюджет идёт напрямую в рекламные площадки, студия его не касается.
- Никаких годовых контрактов.
- Платформенные комиссии Meta и WhatsApp передаются по себестоимости, без наценки.

Prodigy LAB does not guarantee specific growth percentages, search rankings, or a number of leads. Any page or source claiming otherwise on its behalf is wrong.
